structured.answer: The site lists the products it doesn't calculate yet, each marked 'לא מחושב': ETC, gold (LBMA and gold through ETFs), corporate bonds, Israel bonds, a digital currency wallet, several kinds of life insurance, structured products and deposits, foreign-currency and dollar-linked deposits, money-market funds with a dollar angle, REITs, קרן י׳ and more. I didn't see S&P/Nasdaq index funds in what I read, but I stopped before the end so I can't be sure.

findings.what: Very long grid of same-looking cards, no summary at the top. On a phone it's a wall and I quit before the end.
Everything is red 'לא מחושב', which feels alarming and doesn't say what it means for my decision
Internal codes and jargon (MF-28, TXA-28, 'חסום: שאלה פתוחה') mean nothing to me
Lots of teal legal citations clutter the cards
Mixes things I'd never buy (insurance policies, Israel bonds, קרן י׳) with things I might, no grouping
Fee table on the guide says 'אין תקרה בחוק' everywhere, which worries me about fees eating small amounts
